To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a novel Z scheme face to the face CdIn2S/BiOCl heterostructure with enhanced interfacial electron transfer was designed and synthesized, and exhibited excellent photocatalytic performance in the degradation of MO, TCH and RhB under simulated solar light.

we have successfully synthesized a novel Z scheme face to the face heterostructure of CdIn2S/BiOCl with intimate contacted interface, which can provide more charge transfer nanocanels, shorten the migration distance, and enhance the separation of charge carriers.

a novel Z scheme face to f ace heterojunction CdIn2S/BiOCl was designed and synthesized via in situ hydrothermal method, and it exhibited excellent photocatalytic activity for the degradation of MO and TCH under simulated solar light.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the in situ synthesis of Z scheme CdIn 2S4 nano-octahedron/BioCl nanosheet heterostructure via a facile one-step hydrothermal method.
the in situ synthesis and the photocatalytic performance of Z scheme CdIn 2S 4 nano octahedral/BiOCl face to face nanosheet heterostructure.
the design of a novel Z scheme face to-face CIS/BOC nanocomposite with intimate contact heterostructure, which was prepared via an in situ hydrothermal approach.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study has demonstrated the feasibility and potentiality of Z scheme face to-face heterostructure in the photocatalytic field.

a novel Z scheme CIS/BOC nanocomposite photocatalyst with high photocatalytic activity and good stability was successfully synthesized via a facile hydrothermal method and exhibited a promising application in environmental purification.

the as prepared CIS/BOC composite with Z scheme heterostructure and intimate contact interface possessed the optimal photocataytic performance for MO degradation, and the enhanced photocatalytic activity was mainly due to the unique Z scheme heterojunction structure and intimate contact interface.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

Z scheme face to the face CIS/BOC composite photocatalyst with intimate contact and good interface structure was successfully designed and prepared via a facile hydrothermal process, which showed enhanced photocatalytic activity for the degradation of various contaminants under simulated solar light, and this study provided a novel strategy for developing other Z scheme face face heterojunction composite photocatalysts.

the photocatalytic activities could be effectively promoted by constructing Z scheme face to-face heterostructures with intimate interface and high contact efficiency, which would be a promising way to develop high efficient photocatalysts.
a novel Z scheme face toface CdIn2S/BiOCl heterostructure with high photocatalytic activity was successfully designed and prepared via a facile hydrothermal method.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the photocatalytic performance of the Z scheme face to interface CdIn2S/BiOCl composites is better than that of CdIn2S and BiOCl alone, and it can be further improved by increasing the content of BiOCl.
the photocatalytic activity can be significantly enhanced through the Z scheme face to-face heterostructure with the intimate contacted interface.
the photocatalytic performance of CdIn2S 4 can be greatly enhanced by the formation of a Z scheme heterostructure.
